findings.key: Chandragupta Maurya — around 321 BCE comes before around 268 BCE
findings.why: The stem (EN and HI: "Pehle kisne raaj kiya?") never names the two rulers or their dates; they appear only inside the options, and the correct option also contains the explanation. Spoken or shown without options the question is unanswerable. Key itself is correct. Fix: "Who ruled first, Chandragupta Maurya (c. 321 BCE) or Ashoka (c. 268 BCE)?"

hinglish.phrase: harmful microbes ko marne ke liye chlorine use karta hai
hinglish.why: "marne" means to die; killing is "maarne" (microbes ko maarne ke liye).
